text:
IncBot: :rotating_light: Alert: Multiple model warmup failures and node flaps detected in cluster us-west-2. Error signature: warmup_deserialize_error + OOM during load. Paging oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: I'm on it. pulling logs now, can folks avoid rolling any infra changes while we triage? @DeployBot please pause scheduled deploys for us-west-2.
DeployBot: Acknowledged. Pausing deploy queue for us-west-2.
Nate: seeing repeated container restarts on runtime-gpu-03. Kernel logs show CUDA driver errors: "CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION" and OOM at model load. Stack snippets show fail in deserializer: "bad_alloc while mapping weights".
Kim: same here — warmup task hits OOM during deserialization for model-id cv-large-v2: "deserialize_chunk: checksum mismatch" followed by compile timeout at 90s. Looks like partial artifact plus memory spike.
Eva: we've got node flaps: runtime-gpu-02 rebooted twice in the last 6m. kubeevicts for pods running on those nodes. Possibly underlying NIC flaps correlating with storage timeouts.
Maya: customer-impact check: CS Lead, any customers reporting 5xx on hosted API in us-west-2?
CS Lead: yes, Customer ACME app reported 503s starting ~5m ago. They've opened a ticket and escalated to urgent.
Pat: initial mitigation proposal: 1) cordon affected nodes, 2) route traffic to warm standby region (us-east-1), 3) fallback to smaller model variant (cv-medium-v2) for warmup where possible, 4) if artifact checksum mismatch persists, fall back to artifact from S3 replica.
oncall-sre: agreed. Starting cordon and drain of runtime-gpu-02 and runtime-gpu-03. Routing policy -> set region preference to us-east-1 for new requests. Applying canary fallback to cv-medium-v2 for routes pinned to cv-large-v2.
Nate: pushing rollback of recent artifact promotion for cv-large-v2 (it landed 12m ago). I suspect the artifact on the local cache is corrupted.
StorageBot: detected increased S3 GET latency and a few 5xx on the object-store gateway in us-west-2; replicating reads from us-east-1 replica now.
Kim: log dump from one failing warmup pod:
```
[WARN] warmup: starting deserialization for model cv-large-v2
[ERR] deserialize_chunk: checksum mismatch chunk=47 expected=bf12.. got=ad88..
[ERR] allocate_weights: bad_alloc size=2.1GB
[ERR] compile_kernels: timeout after 90s
[CRIT] runtime: fatal OOM while loading model
```
Maya: customer-facing note: ACME is experiencing 503 on embeddings endpoint. ETA for full mitigation?
Pat: immediate mitigation: traffic shift + fallback to cv-medium-v2 should restore availability for most queries within 2-4 minutes. Artifact swap may take 8-12 minutes depending on replication.
CS Lead: I'll tell ACME: we're routing traffic to a healthy region and using a compatible model variant to restore service. Expect degraded latency for some requests, but functionally available. I'll post update in the ticket.
oncall-sre: cordon/drain complete for runtime-gpu-02 and runtime-gpu-03. Kube scheduler placed pods on runtime-gpu-06 and runtime-gpu-09 in us-west-2; those are stable. We've also bumped autoscale min for dedicated pools to prevent warmup stampede.
Nate: artifact check: local cache at /var/lib/model-cache showed truncated file for cv-large-v2; checksum differs from S3. Replacing with us-east-1 replica via `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-replica/models/cv-large-v2 /var/lib/model-cache/` and validating checksum.
Kim: compile-timeouts dropped after switching to replica artifact. A few pods still OOM on warmup due to large sequence-length defaults; changed warmup hook to stream-only prefix loading to reduce peak.
Maya: CS Lead confirmed ACME saw service restoration after fallback; followed up with note about potential degraded latency and different embedding dims if using cv-medium-v2.
CS Lead: ACME accepted mitigation and asked for postmortem and ETA for full return to original model.
Pat: next steps: 1) continue artifact validation across all us-west-2 cache nodes, 2) run a controlled repush of validated artifact to local caches, 3) audit recent artifact promotion job (Nate), 4) add checksum verification into warmup path to fail fast and avoid partial loads.
Nate: I've flagged the promotion job build #1982 — it reported success but hash mismatch later. Opening an issue and blocking further promotions until we add end-to-end verification.
StorageBot: background replication from us-east-1 to us-west-2 replica 50% complete; expected to finish in ~10m.
oncall-sre: handing off to afternoon oncall (Maya) once stable. I'll leave runbook notes in the channel and mark incident as "mitigated - degraded" for tracking. @Maya please take ownership for follow-up and postmortem.
Maya: taking over. Will coordinate with Infra to hard-evict corrupted cache entries and schedule a rolling validation. Will draft postmortem and include customer timeline.
IncBot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, impact=partial outage for some hosted API customers (503s), mitigation=traffic re-route + model fallback, owner=Maya, status=mitigated-degraded.
CS Lead: ACME updated: service restored, asked for timeline and root cause. I'll share postmortem when ready. Thanks team.
Nate: opened GH issue rwinf/artifact-promotion#423 with logs and reproduction steps.
Maya: note for postmortem: investigate why warmup didn't detect checksum mismatch earlier and why compile timeouts coincided with OOM. Also propose adding smaller warmup memory footprint option and auto-fallback threshold for compile timeouts.
Pat: closing notes: once replication completes and we validate replicas, we can roll back to cv-large-v2 with gradual canary. No current customer-facing SLA breach beyond temporary degraded service.
CS Lead: I'll keep ACME updated and confirm closure once rollback is finished.
